description: Develop pi-web and the pi extension repos of this project (pi-sync, pi-projects, pi-background, pi-keepalive, pi-mounts, pi-secret-broker, pi-summarize, pi-worktree-include): work in a worktree, run the repo's tests, push agent/<name> (in pi-web, feature/<name> also deploys preview), open a PR and merge it with `gh pr merge --auto --squash` once CI passes. Merging pi-web or pi-sync deploys production. Changes under .pi/, .github/ and deploy paths wait for Bryan.
